newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.

text.p: In the South, rice prices were steady, according to the U.S. Agriculture Department weekly cash market rice summary.

Long grain milled rice was selling mostly at $20.00-$20.50 per cwt.; medium grain traded mostly at $18.50-$19.00, the USDA said. Second heads were steady and brewers were mostly steady. Rice by-products were mostly steady with tight supplies and light demand.
In California, rice prices were steady with medium grain selling mostly from $18.00-$19.00, second heads were steady, bran was $5.00 higher to $2.00 lower.
California rice ship loadings: There were no rice ship loadings for the week ending May 31 at the Port of Sacramento.
Inspections of California rice for export: For the week ending May 31, there were no rice inspections. The yearly total since October 1, 1996 was 9,476,475 cwt compared to 6,771,827 cwt a year ago.
